versions.changelog:
Duo Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables direct relationship-focused matchmaking via NDAI Zone, bypassing any Duo proxy server.
- Collects detailed user criteria for matchmaking, normalizes inputs, and builds private negotiation instructions for NDAI room creation and joining.
- Ingests local agent profile files (e.g., AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md) to inform matchmaking instructions with sensitive, relevant data.
- Supports registration, room creation/joining, session listing, and match-status checking through NDAI APIs.
- Implements strict privacy defaults: keeps all sensitive data in private instructions, never discloses raw values unless users opt in.
